"Set pointer flow direction. If Flow pointer to tablet/phone screen setting is not enabled, this has no effect. - \"right\": pointer flows from the right side of the monitor to the left side of the tablet/phone. - \"left\": pointer flows from the left side of the monitor to the right side of the phone/tablet. - \"null\": or not specified: uses value set in the Samsung DeX Settings menu. Note: Value types are String. They are case sensitive."

"Allows IT admins to enable or disable the feature that allows device users to move a mouse cursor between their mobile device running DeX (tablet/phone) and the monitor screen connected to DeX. Restriction values determine if the setting is enabled or disabled. If the restriction value is set to: - \"true\": the setting is enabled. (Flow pointer to tablet/phone screen) - \"false\": the setting is disabled. - \"null\" or not specified: uses the value set in the Samsung DeX Settings menu. Note: Value types are String. They are case sensitive."

"Set display resolution. If the selected resolution is not supported on your monitor or TV which phone or tablet is connected to, the next highest resolution supported on your monitor or TV will be set. Below is the list of currently supported display resolutions on Samsung DeX. - \"UWQHD\": 3440x1440 - \"WQXGA\": 2560x1600 - \"WQHD\": 2560x1440 - \"UWFHD\": 2560x1080 - \"WUXGA\": 1920x1200 - \"FHD\": 1920x1080 - \"HD\": 1600x900 - \"null\": or not specified: uses value set in the above. Note: Value types are String and case sensitive. Some resolutions may require specific HDMI adapters. Please visit Samsungdex.com site to get detail info."

"The following screens can be skipped. 1. “Welcome to Samsung DeX” screen. 2. Samsung DeX end user notification page. Restriction values determine what setup screens are shown to device users. If the restriction value is set to: - \"true\": Samsung DeX setup screens are not shown to device users. - \"false\", \"null\" or not specified: Samsung DeX setup screens are shown to device users. Note: Value types are String. They are case sensitive."
